definition: NecessaryImplication A a q p means at every accessible world truth of q implies truth of p. For the C/N/S interpretation q represents all relevant total-ground conditions including enablers; the theorem itself is a modal schema and does not establish that any supplied q is complete, actual or explanatory.
note: Analyst framework for #545, not independently established metaphysical applicability. See docs/notes/grounding-baseline-545.md for examples, exclusions, structural properties and strongest rival replies.
